independence_limit: All roles are instances of the same model family in one session. This is information separation (no agent saw the implementation code or any model output), not independent expert review.
spec_clarified_between_construction_and_: The author noted three gaps; they were stated in the spec (and the code, where needed) before the review: a question naming a family and one sub-code uses the sub-code; the leave-out rule for sub-code parts applies only when listed items are asked; English document words (passport, certificate, application form) cover documents. The author's suite already followed the first two readings, and no case depends on the third. The reviewer used the clarified spec and agreed on every spec-derived value.
review_result: All spec-derived values, including the sub-code parts and question cleaning, matched the reviewer in all 81 cases.
